Business Innovation and Sustainability, Bachelor and Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration (3 + 2 yrs), autumn 2027
Jyväskylä University School of Business and Economics

kuvaus.en: Are you interested in sustainability, international business, corporate social responsibility, innovation management, strategy, or entrepreneurship? Do you want to be a change maker and create an impact on business and society? Join us and develop your science-based business skills at the Jyväskylä University School of Business and Economics (JSBE). Our Bachelor’s Degree Programme in Business Innovation and Sustainability (BIS) is offered entirely in English. Jyväskylä University School of Business and Economics is AACSB, AMBA, and BGA accredited unit, which reflects the international high quality both in research and in teaching. The bachelor's programme is 180 ECTS. After graduation, students can also continue to the master's programme, which is 120 ECTS.

No scholarships are offered for the first year. A tuition fee scholarship of 3,000€ will be granted for your second and third year of studies if you complete at least 55 ECTS during the preceding academic year (and are liable to pay tuition fees). If you complete the programme within three academic years, you will be granted a scholarship for the master’s studies as well. The scholarship amount varies depending on the tuition fee amount in the master's programme.

For more information, please see: Tuition fees and scholarships (jyu.fi).

maksullisuusKuvaus.en:
A 1,500 € early bird discount from the first year tuition fee is offered to those who accept their study place within 14 days and pay the annual tuition fee by the deadline. You are not required to pay tuition fees if you are a citizen of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland or hold a specific type of residence permit in Finland. For more information, please see: Tuition fees and scholarships (jyu.fi).

The full tuition fee in the bachelor's programme is 10,000 € per year. The full tuition fee in master's programmes at JSBE is 10,000 or 12,000 € per year. Please see additional information on the JYU website.

suunniteltuKestoKuvaus.en: After the 3-year bachelor's programme, you can continue directly to a 2-year Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration degree.

teksti.en: The BIS Bachelor's programme offers you a gateway to JSBE’s well-known and popular master’s programmes (M.Sc.): Master’s degree programmes in International Business and Entrepreneurship (IBE), Corporate Environmental management (CEM), Digital Marketing and Corporate Communication (DMCC), and Responsible Management and Business of Sport (RESPO). This option – after the bachelor level graduation – enables you even more career opportunities and new academic research skills and pathway to study at the international M.Sc. programmes at the University of Jyväskylä School of Business and Economics. M.Sc. Programmes at JYU is a great pathway for doctoral studies and post-doc career.
See the detailed structure of the programme at our study guide.

Student profile contains potential students with interest towards business and innovating, and on making career in the companies. In addition to that student profile covers applicants with good argumentation and language skills. Priority will be given to those applicants who are eligible based on the selection criteria of the BIS programme.

By graduating at the bachelor's degree level, you can work at multiple junior level positions in firms and public organizations. Typical entry level jobs relate to consulting, corporate social responsibility, sustainable business, business process management, customer interface, and sales.

Co-operation is done with academic and industry experts of the field. Advisory group of the BIS supports interaction between industry and academia. Its members are from companies and organizations related to the BIS programme core topics of business, sustainability, and strategy. Many of our faculty participate firm management in the roles of board member or specialist, entrepreneurial ecosystems, and teachers in executive education programmes. Collectively, they offer experience from multinational and Finnish firms such as Kesko, Metsä Group, and Valtra. Others bring executive-level insights from entrepreneurial and venture capital initiatives.

The BIS programme offers opportunities for student exchange in some of our collaborative universities around the world. University of Jyväskylä and JYU School of Business and Economics offers extensive number of good quality universities for exchange programme. Internationalization takes place also by the BIS course studies which are taught in English and by the thesis written in English. Students of the BIS come around the world, enabling international team working and studying together. Team working in English and other activities increase not just language skills but also relevant business skills. Many of our teaching staff members are international. Most of the staff members have multiple experiences on teaching and research exchange in other well-known business schools such as University of Lausanne, University of St. Gallen, Stockholm University, Copenhagen Business School, and University of Karlstad among others.

Qualitification of the degree is related to new knowledge creation and business skills. By attending the Bachelor of Innovation and Sustainable Business (BIS) programme you learn science-based thinking and logic in business and sustainability. Our courses support business skills to create new knowledge.  You also get the benefits of a small programme: Our courses take place in smaller groups where you get to interact directly with teachers and other students. You get personal counseling and personal study plan individually tailored for your career purposes.In our programme in Business Innovation and Sustainability, you learn about the management of business innovations, sustainable management, new business creation, decision-making, and sustainability transition. This programme also offers high-quality elective studies in digital marketing, responsible management, and entrepreneurship, among others. In addition, we provide multiple opportunities for student exchange and trainee periods in companies.

Thesis is done at the end of the bachelor level studies. It is done in synergy with the capstone course and other relevant courses, and it can be done as a literature-based study or as an empirical study, typically for a company.

Research focus is on topics related to strategy, sustainable business, innovation and entrepreneurship. Research is conducted internationally in high quality journals. Professors and other staff members of the BIS programme have published in leading journals of the field such as Strategic Management Journal, Academy of Management Review, Journal of Business Ethics, and Organization Studies and other FT50 ranked journals.

kuvaus.en:
The required application attachments are listed below. Some attachments may be optional or apply only to some applicant groups. Any documents not listed below will not be considered in the evaluation process.

If any compulsory attachments have not been submitted according to our instructions or in time to meet the given deadline(s), your application will be deemed ineligible and not processed further. The detailed instructions for attachments will be published on the University’s website before the application period opens. The instructions may change between application rounds, and you must make sure to comply with the requirements for the correct round.

1. Educational documents proving your eligibility for bachelor’s-level studies.
If the documents are issued in a language other than English, Finnish, or Swedish, an official translation into one of these languages is required in addition to the original language version.

2. SAT or ACT score report (Admission groups 2 & 3).
Attach a test taker’s score report on to the online application form. In addition, make sure that your scores are delivered to the University of Jyväskylä directly from the test organiser by the given deadline.

Only SAT and ACT tests taken on or after 21 January 2022 are accepted.

Please see further information on applying with an SAT or an ACT test result and how to deliver the scores to the University of Jyväskylä at our web page.

3. Proof of English skills.
The required document is an aptitude test result, language test certificate, or an educational document, depending on how you prove your language skills. See Eligibility criteria for the approved methods.

4. Copy of a valid passport (needed if you are not a Finnish citizen).
A copy of the identification page(s) of a valid passport with the applicant’s name, date of birth, and nationality. If you do not hold a valid passport, another official identification document (such as an identity card or driver's license) stating the same information is accepted. If you are a Finnish citizen, this document is not required.

5. Copy of a residence permit card (if applicable).
A copy of both sides of the residence permit card. The document is required only if you, the applicant, hold one of the following: a valid residence permit in Finland of type A (that is not based on studies), P, P-EU, EU Blue Card, or a certificate of the permanent right of residence of a UK citizen in Finland, or residence card for a family member of an EU or UK citizen residing in Finland.
